set: A: surface and detail, the ten keys whole

issues.where: the clear tube below the porthole, right side, at the two lower rings
issues.what: its shadow on the page breaks into detached dark diagonal wedges beside each ring, with no continuous contact shadow along the tube; it reads as a composited overlay, not a tube lying on or standing off the page
issues.fix: cast one continuous shadow for the tube, with a tight dark line where the rings come closest to the page and a softer falloff beyond, and no separate wedges

issues.where: the backbox, 'THE DAILY GRIND' over the skyline
issues.what: the title is flat type sitting on a flat skyline picture, with no glass, no backlight and no bevel, so it looks like a pasted banner and not lit translite art
issues.fix: put the art behind a glass face with a reflection and an even backlight glow, and give the title a printed or embossed finish that belongs to the art

issues.where: the wire ramp's entry plate, upper left of centre
issues.what: the entry plate is a plain grey box with no flap, no rivets or screws and no lip down to the floor; it is the one stock box on a detailed table
issues.fix: model a proper ramp entrance: a thin steel flap with a lip onto the playfield, screw heads, and a small contact shadow

issues.where: the 'Background Check' sign inside the spiral tower
issues.what: the sign is cut through by the spiral ramp and its text is unreadable, so the sign and the ramp seem to share the same space
issues.fix: move the sign clear of the spiral or mount it above, so it sits in front with a gap

issues.what: the scrolling text is caught mid-scroll as '(In Lieu of', clipped at the left; on a still this reads as cropped text
issues.fix: choose a frame where the message is whole, or let the text scroll in from a clean margin

issues.where: the spinner by the red carpet and the ball
issues.what: the spinner's arms run under the ball's edge with no shadow or gap where they cross, so the height order is unclear
issues.fix: cast the ball's shadow onto the spinner arm and keep a visible gap between them

issues.what: the office interiors repeat the same small white blocks floor after floor, which shows the tiling at a glance
issues.fix: vary the interiors from floor to floor (lights on or off, different desks, blinds)

issues.where: the apron at the bottom edge
issues.what: strong depth of field softens the apron's lower edge into smear, and the fine print there goes soft
issues.fix: ease the blur or move the focal plane down a little so the near apron stays crisp
